blocks.text: Nitrogen hawa ka bara hissa hai. Yeh bohat kam react karti hai, kyun ke (1) is ka size chhota hai, (2) is ka electron cloud symmetrical (har taraf barabar) hai, aur (3) is ka triple bond non-polar hai. Nitrogen ki electronic configuration 1s² 2s² 2p³ hai, yani octet poora karne ke liye ise teen electrons chahiye. Is liye do nitrogen atoms teen teen electrons share kar ke triple bond banate hain (Figure 12.1). Is bond ki bond enthalpy +944 kJmol⁻¹ hai. Naye bond banane se pehle yeh bond torna parta hai, aur is ke liye bohat energy chahiye; is liye N₂ bohat unreactive hai. Doosri wajah bond ka non-polar hona hai: dono atoms ek jaise hain, electronegativity ka farq sifar (zero) hai, is liye teenon bonded pairs dono atoms mein barabar share hote hain.

blocks.alt: Do bare daire ek doosre par chadhe hue, har ek ke andar N ke gird chhota daira. Baen chhote daire par neele nuqton ka jora aur daen par surkh jora. Bilkul baen kinare par neela jora aur daen kinare par surkh jora. Jahan dono bare daire milte hain wahan chhe nuqte, bari bari neele aur surkh, ek qatar mein. Daen taraf N≡N likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.1: N2 molecule mein bonding (kitab ki Figure 12.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neele nuqte baen N ke electrons hain aur surkh nuqte daen N ke. Dono daire jahan milte hain wahan teen jore (chhe electrons) baante (shared) gaye hain: yahi teen bonds, yani N≡N triple bond hai. Har N ke bahar wale kinare par ek akela jora (lone pair) hai, aur chhote daire par andar wale khol (inner shell) ke do electrons. Is tarah har N ke bahar wale khol mein aath electrons poore ho jate hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat (Interesting Information)
blocks.text: Hawa mein nitrogen ki zyada miqdar oxygen ko halka (dilute) kar deti hai; is liye fiza mein har chingari (spark) bari aag nahi bhadkati. Jahazon par hydrocarbons ya khaane ke tel (edible oils) ki bari khep ko oxygen aur nami (moisture) se bachane ke liye un par nitrogen ya kisi aur inert gas ka 'kambal' (blanket) dala jata hai. Laboratory mein bhi woh reactions jin ko inert mahol chahiye, nitrogen mein kiye jate hain.

blocks.prompt: N₂ ki kam reactivity (inertness) ki do wajuhat batayein (exercise Q.2a).
blocks.explanation: (1) N≡N triple bond bohat mazboot hai (+944 kJmol⁻¹); naye bond banne se pehle ise torna parta hai. (2) Bond non-polar hai: dono atoms ek jaise hain, is liye molecule par koi positive ya negative sira nahi jahan reagent hamla kar sake.

items: N₂ inert hai: mazboot triple bond (+944 kJmol⁻¹), non-polar bond, chhota size aur symmetrical electron cloud.
Nitrogen hawa mein oxygen ko dilute karti hai aur jahazon aur laboratory mein inert 'blanket' ka kaam deti hai.
